name: List CRM contact attributes
description: Call this when you need the schema of contact fields the CRM knows about — their keys, labels, value types, and whether each is a system field or read-only — before reading or writing contact data on deals, pipelines, or CRM forms. Use it to resolve a human-facing field label to the attribute key other calls expect, and to find out which fields must be left alone because they are system-owned or read-only. This returns definitions of fields, not any contact's values: to read or change values on a specific contact, use the contacts actions instead; to fetch the attribute definitions for a non-contact CRM object such as a deal or a company, use the equivalent object-schema action for that object type.
preconditions: The session must be authenticated against the CRM backend for an account that has CRM enabled.

attributes.description: One entry per contact attribute defined for the account, including built-in system fields.

key.description: Stable identifier for the attribute, typically upper case (e.g. "FIRSTNAME", "LASTNAME"). This is the value other calls expect when referring to the field.

label.description: Human-facing name shown in the CRM UI for this attribute.

type.description: Value type of the attribute, e.g. "text" as seen in the evidence. The full set of types is not established by the evidence.

object_type.description: The CRM object the attribute belongs to; "contact" for every entry returned here.

is_system.description: True when the attribute is built into the product rather than created by the account.

owner.description: Identifier of the account or tenant the attribute belongs to.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the attribute was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the attribute was last modified.

modification_metadata.description: Flags describing how the attribute may be changed.

is_read_only.description: True when the attribute's definition cannot be edited.

additional_metadata.description: Extra attribute details. Observed to carry the underlying contact field name.

field_key.description: Lower-case internal field name backing this attribute, e.g. "firstname".
